code_hints: If PLP tiles are not found within 5-7s on any page matching /en-gb, navigate to the configured start_url (/en-gb/men/ready-to-wear/down-jackets) as a fallback.
Before PLP waits, click the OneTrust consent button if present: query #onetrust-accept-btn-handler and click once.
After PLP container appears, perform incremental scroll-to-bottom to trigger lazy loading, up to 8 rounds or until no new items.
Extract PDP price by first reading meta[itemprop='price'] content attribute; if absent, fall back to text from .price__amount or [itemprop='price'].
Deduplicate PDP links and keep only anchors ending with .html within the PLP container; ignore non-product .html links outside the PLP container.
rationale: We landed on the homepage (no tiles). Directly entering a known PLP path avoids geo/country overlays and ensures tiles render. OneTrust cookie consent likely blocks interaction; clicking it resolves. PLP/PDP selectors target Moncler’s AEM components and schema.org markup, with fallbacks. URL normalization pins the en-gb locale and blocks redirects to monclergroup.com or non-product areas, reducing traps.
